headlines.text: Rewind to 2022, when Lance Archer stepped back through the curtain after 3 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

Rewind to 2024, when Kris Statlander reached a genuine milestone: their 50th match in AEW, facing Kris Statlander vs. Queen Aminata on Rampage, rated 6.41 in a big night for the women's side of the roster.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Darby Allin vs. Jeff Hardy headlined Rampage, rated 7.46 ? a solid showing.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2022, it was the first-ever encounter between Allin & Sting and The Acclaimed, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 6.37.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Chris Jericho vs. Matt Sydal crossed paths for the first time ever, kicking off the show on Rampage, rated 6.03.
